evidence_tier: REAL. Block B2: score-granularity variants of claims, temper collapse in the Block A paired-difference form, 300 trials per cell. The discreteness half of critique defect D4.
question: Does score granularity carry the gap between measured paired-difference slopes and the local-slope-ratio kappa_pred that Block A found (coarsest environment steepest)?

predictions.PB2-1: Gates, from the disclosed audit: variant (4, 80) FAILS G5 with 13 distinct scores (floor 20) and its battery is an out-of-gate boundary probe, excluded from within-gate claims; variant (10, 20) passes G5 (74 cells) and G3 (+0.090).
predictions.PB2-2: Measured temper paired-difference slope decreases with granularity: slope(4, 80) > 1.249 (the archived 7, 40 value) > slope(10, 20).
predictions.PB2-3: The amplification gap, slope minus the variant's audit kappa_pred (disclosed: 1.040 / 1.058 / 1.077 for coarse / base / fine), shrinks monotonically with granularity. This is the direct discreteness test: if plateau coarseness is what kappa_pred misses, the gap must close as plateaus vanish.
predictions.PB2-4: Battery-measured oracle conservatism follows the audit ordering: |oracle excess| (4, 80) > (7, 40; archived -0.0039) > (10, 20).

falsifiers.PB2-2/3: Slope or gap NOT falling with granularity exonerates plateau discreteness, and the environment-label residue in Block A A3 needs another suspect; Block B3's induction-family probe becomes the carrier of that question.
falsifiers.PB2-4: Conservatism not shrinking with granularity would break the intercept-equals-plateau-overshoot account of F17 and reopen it.

decision_rule: Slopes fitted through origin on paired differences vs aligned error over the 16 temper cells per variant (gamma = 1 cells carry zero weight in the fit); monotonicity claims on point estimates with adjacent inversions within 2 combined SE tolerated; the out-of-gate variant is reported in full and labelled in every artifact.
notes: Design-phase audit, disclosed and never citable: variant inductions gave rules/cells 13/13, 50/46, 127/74; G3 lifts +0.084 to +0.090; kappa_pred 1.040, 1.058, 1.077; oracle excess -0.0093, -0.0039, -0.0033 (60-trial probes). The audit numbers appear in PB2-3/4 as inputs, not as evidence.

verdicts.PB2-1: CONFIRMED as disclosed: (4, 80) fails G5 with 13 cells and is labelled out-of-gate throughout; (10, 20) passes (74 cells).
verdicts.PB2-2: MISS: slopes are 1.304 (coarse, out-of-gate), 1.249 (archived base), 1.367 (fine): non-monotone, with the FINE variant steepest. Coarseness does not drive the paired-difference slope.
verdicts.PB2-3: MISS: gaps to audit kappa_pred are 0.264, 0.191, 0.290: non-monotone, largest on the finest variant. Plateau discreteness is EXONERATED as the cause of the kappa_pred gap, per the registered falsifier; the environment-label residue in Block A A3 still lacks a carrier, and B3's induction-family result becomes the live probe.
verdicts.PB2-4: CONFIRMED: oracle conservatism orders exactly with coarseness (-0.0090, -0.0039, -0.0031), which is the second independent confirmation of F17's intercept mechanism (plateau overshoot).
verdicts.headline: Granularity splits cleanly: it owns the INTERCEPT of the affine law and does not own the SLOPE gap.
